opening.argument: The strongest evidence presents a free MetaMask trading bot alongside a specific promised return: the title says, “Metamask trading Bot +432$ per day | Metamask Bot | Free download 2022.” The description then supplies a password-protected PancakeSwap archive, giving both a download link and the password: “Download link: https://github.com/Tradebotcrypt/bot/releases/download/v1.2/GhostSniper_Pancakeswap.zip Password: 1111.” The application shown includes a token-contract-address field, APPROVE control, amount and gas fields, and BUY controls, while another screen explicitly shows an attempt to buy BUSD in normal mode. Together, these materials promote a downloadable tool tied to wallet-linked token trading and a stated daily return. The records do not establish that the archive was safe or functional, or that the claimed return was achieved, so the evidence supports the promotional claim without overclaiming its result.
